Okay, now i need to upgrade my app. You need to create several agents:
Upgrade chatbot into an orchestrator that controls other agents.
When user gives it a directory path, orchestrator should function like this:
1.1: Calls sorting agent that returns JSON that looks like this:
{
    "text_agent": [
        "file1.txt",
        "file2.txt",
        etc.
    ],
    "image_agent": [
        "file1.jpg",
        "file2.png",
    ],
    "coding_agent": [
         "file1.cpp",
         "file2.py", 
    ]
}

Text_agent supports following extensions: .txt, .md, .rtf, .csv, .tsv, .json, .xml, .yml/.yaml, .ini/.cfg/.conf, .log, .tex, .rst
Image_agent supports following extensions: .raw, .jpg, .png, .tiff, .bmp, .gif
Coding_agent supports following extensions: .cpp, .c, .py
Files with other extensions should be ignored.
1.2: Calls text_agent, image_agent and coding_agent. Gives each on input JSON that contains their part (for example: image_agent gets image_agent part) from previous JSON and on output gets JSON that looks like this:
{
    "file1": [
        "tag1",
        "tag2",
        etc.
    ]
    etc.
}

DONT CODE the internals of Text_agent, Image_agent and Coding_agent. Write only the input and output part.

1.3 Calls directory_agent. Gives on input JSON that combines JSONs from Text_agent, Image_agent and Coding_agent. Creates directory tree and sorts files depending on the input JSON. 

DONT CODE the internals of directory_agent. Write only the input part.

1.4 Returns the following message to user: "I sorted {"path_to_directory"} directory. If you dont like the way i sorted files you can ask me to reverse changes i made."

1.5 If an agent returns an invalid, empty JSON or JSON is written not on english language, orchestrator should recall the agent that failed. Maximum tries: 4. If after 4 tries called agent returns an invalid JSON, orchestrator should end the work return the following message:
"I failed to to sort {"path_to_directory"} directory. Maybe something is wrong with files in this directory. Try to give me another directory."

1.6 If a combined weight of files that exceeds more than 1 GB then orchestrator should return the following message:
"I failed to to sort {"path_to_directory"} directory. Try to give me directory that contains less files or split the given folder on several folders.

The tools to create these agents are the same as previously declared.
